description: Reflected XSS where user input is written directly into the HTML body without encoding. Canonical textbook test uses a harmless alert/script marker to prove script execution.
detection_method: Response-intelligence engine flags an unescaped reflection in html_body context, corroborated by a new <script> tag or inline event handler appearing in the DOM diff versus baseline.

description: User input reflected inside an HTML attribute value; an unescaped quote character can allow breaking out of the attribute to inject a new one, such as an event handler.
detection_method: Reflection indicator with context=html_attribute and html_escaped=false, combined with a new inline event-handler attribute observed in DOM diff.

description: Client-side JavaScript reads an attacker-influenced value (URL fragment, postMessage, storage) and writes it into the DOM via an unsafe sink (innerHTML, document.write, eval) without server round-trip.
detection_method: Requires JS-aware crawling (katana) to trace source->sink data flow; static analysis of fetched JS for known unsafe sinks combined with reachable attacker-controlled sources.

description: Input submitted in one request (e.g. a comment, profile field) is persisted and rendered unescaped to other users on a later, different request.
detection_method: Requires a two-step check: submit a unique marker via a write endpoint, then fetch a separate read endpoint/view and look for an unescaped reflection of that marker.
